title: TikTok Video Link Checker — Validate Public Video URLs
description: Check whether a full public TikTok video URL has a valid host, creator path and video ID. No login, media fetch or download delivery is provided.
intro: Paste a full public TikTok video link to validate its host, creator path and video ID. TokProfile does not currently fetch or download the media file.

tips.title: Confirm ownership or permission
tips.description: A valid URL never replaces copyright, creator consent or the license needed for reuse.

tips.title: Inspect the parsed identity

tips.title: Understand the limitation
tips.description: The current result validates URL structure only. It does not prove availability, ownership or permission and does not return media.

faqDescription: Accepted URLs, parsed fields, rights boundaries and current media limitations.

faq.question: What URLs does the TikTok video link checker accept?
faq.answer: The validator accepts full HTTPS TikTok video URLs such as tiktok.com/@creator/video/123. Profile pages, short links and other domains are rejected.

faq.question: Does a valid result mean I can save the video?
faq.answer: No. The result confirms supported URL structure only. It does not grant rights, prove media availability or return a video file.

faq.question: Does TokProfile fetch or store the video?
faq.answer: No. The current checker parses and validates the submitted URL. It does not fetch the video bytes or maintain a user-media library.

faq.question: Why is there no download button after a valid result?
faq.answer: No verified media source is connected. TokProfile shows the actual validation result instead of enabling a button that cannot deliver a real file.

faq.question: How does TokProfile protect the checker?
faq.answer: The checker uses an HTTPS TikTok domain whitelist, strict video-path validation, small JSON request bodies and request limits. It does not request arbitrary URLs or fetch media bytes.

howToSteps.title: 1. Copy one video link
howToSteps.description: Open the public video in TikTok, choose Share, then select Copy link.

howToSteps.title: 2. Paste and confirm rights
howToSteps.description: Paste the full link and confirm that you own the video or have permission for your intended use.

howToSteps.title: 3. Review the parsed result
howToSteps.description: TokProfile checks the domain and path, then shows the creator handle and video ID when the URL is supported.

downloadLocations.title: Supported result
downloadLocations.description: A supported result shows the creator handle and video identifier parsed from the submitted canonical URL.

downloadLocations.title: Unsupported result

downloadLocations.title: No media delivery
downloadLocations.description: The current checker does not request video bytes, create a temporary media file or place anything in your Downloads folder.

helpItems.title: Use a link to one public video
helpItems.description: Copy the original video URL again if you pasted a profile, search result, short link or unrelated page.

helpItems.title: Read the returned fields
helpItems.description: The creator handle and video ID come from the URL. They are not a live media, privacy or ownership check.

helpItems.title: Respect access and ownership limits
helpItems.description: Private, removed or restricted media is unavailable, and technical availability never replaces permission.

ui.safetyDescription: TokProfile checks only supported public TikTok video URLs. It does not fetch or store video bytes, bypass private content controls, grant reuse rights or enable an unavailable download.

safetyControls.title: TikTok-only URL whitelist
safetyControls.description: Only full HTTPS video URLs on tiktok.com and approved subdomains pass validation.

safetyControls.title: Request rate limits
safetyControls.description: Preview requests are limited per anonymized client identifier to reduce abuse.

safetyControls.title: File validation
safetyControls.description: Media must pass MIME type, declared length, size and MP4 signature checks.

safetyControls.title: Isolated temporary storage
safetyControls.description: Validated bytes use random server-generated names and restricted file permissions.

safetyControls.title: Short retention
safetyControls.description: Temporary media expires after a maximum of 15 minutes.

safetyControls.title: Automatic cleanup
safetyControls.description: Expired files are removed and successful delivery consumes the temporary copy.
